decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template sits close to the firm's agency hosting expertise, so it can interpret results and refine the template cheaply with its in-house R&D.
A responsive website template complements the CMS hosting offer and uses existing know-how, though templates may quietly lose prominence.
Premium support builds directly on the firm's core 24/7 expert support competence and agency focus, making it easy to assimilate and improve.
The version management tool extends the firm's own developer tooling and has its own page, fitting its continuous software development and related knowledge.

The data processing contract generator lies far from the firm's technical knowledge, which weakens learning from early results, but it serves GDPR needs of existing customers at low upkeep, so keeping it is marginally favored.
